scopes.label: repository governance and routing
scopes.rule: Route the task to the owning path before editing. Runtime, popup, secondary-window, and bundle changes require the real build or runtime guard selected by the impact checker.

scopes.label: desktop WebView UI, workspaces, and domains
scopes.rule: Access the local runtime only through apps/desktop/web/src/api/index.ts. Keep business truth in the runtime, update all five locales, and run the generated bundle checks for popup or secondary-window changes.

scopes.label: local application and data runtime
scopes.rule: Change contracts/openapi/desktop-local-api.v1.yaml before a route shape, then regenerate. Preserve local-only behavior, cancellation, bounded inputs, rollback, and atomic persistence.

scopes.label: Tauri lifecycle, native bridge, and local packaging
scopes.rule: Keep native commands inside contracts/native-bridge/native-bridge.v1.json. Core shell code has no official service, updater, Store, signing, or notarization implementation.

scopes.label: redistributable desktop seed data
scopes.rule: Every dataset must match its manifest and THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md record. Never commit caches, generated databases, proprietary data, or machine paths.

scopes.label: shared local contracts, validation, domain facts, and i18n
scopes.rule: Do not hand-edit generated contract outputs. Keep the five locales complete and exclude hosted-service implementation types.

scopes.label: versioned local HTTP and native bridge contracts
scopes.rule: Contracts describe local desktop behavior only. Change the contract first, regenerate, and do not add aliases, fallback hosts, or official-service surfaces.

scopes.label: generation, quality, compliance, and local Core build tools
scopes.rule: Tooling may build and validate Core only. Update the matching registry and tests when a generator, quality route, or public-boundary rule changes.
